title: Orbits and numerical error
summary: Field-guide chapter 1: the Kepler two-body problem integrated with explicit Euler, semi-implicit Euler, leapfrog KDK and RK4. Energy and angular-momentum error against the analytic ellipse, validated case by case against an independent Python reference.

sources: Hairer, Lubich & Wanner, Geometric Numerical Integration, 2nd ed., Springer 2006
Goldstein, Poole & Safko, Classical Mechanics, 3rd ed., ch. 3
Battin, An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics, rev. ed., ch. 4
Wisdom & Holman, Symplectic maps for the n-body problem, AJ 102 (1991) 1528
